# What will this workflow cost you a month?

> Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and see projected monthly billable minutes and cost, with the macOS 10x multiplier and cron costs flagged. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
